tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: List every task SwishrJobs can execute, with each one's inputs, deliverables, price, and whether it can run right now.

tools.name: get_performance
tools.description: Return the measured success rate, latency, and expected cost per accepted result for each capability, from controlled synthetic benchmarks. A capability that has not been benchmarked reports measured=false with a null success rate; no rate is ever invented. These are not customer outcomes.

tools.name: select_capability

tools.name: preflight_job
